Verified eligible L1 source class with live FD exclusion

No re-accumulation after two natural cycles
Actual byte delta measured and snapshots accounted
Protected personal/source/financial material excluded
Installed cryptographically signed original owner class and purpose
Root durable one-use nonce and revocation denial
Separate COPY and RETIRE original verifier boundary
Original highest historical L4 human / L5 never-delete tested
A legitimate original retirement with native before/after and rollback health
Ciphertext source and destination digest with durable ACK
Independent full content reread verified
Isolated restoration against exact source object and inventory
Original remains until distinct verified signed retirement
Recovery fire drill verified across active and rollback cohorts
